title: API monitor
subtitle: Public API traffic and source evidence
error: Could not load API statistics. Please retry.
unavailable: Monitoring is unavailable. Check the D1 binding and monitoring migration.
empty: No records in this period. Requests will be recorded after release.
sourceHint: Sources are inferred from Referer / Origin, which may be missing or forged. An AppID match is not authentication, and unknown traffic is not proof of misuse.
coverageHint: Only public requests reaching server code are counted. Use Cloudflare analytics for CDN hits, WAF blocks and direct R2 access. Timing ends at response headers, not download completion.
retentionHint: Seven days of detail, gradually cleaned up as requests arrive. Times use Asia/Shanghai.
thresholdHint: Flag a fixed minute when one IP reaches {requests} requests, {downloads} downloads or {targets} distinct resources. Investigation only; no automatic blocking.
normalHint: The same thresholds apply to WeChat traffic. Shared IPs and legitimate batch activity may trigger flags.
alertsEmpty: No minute windows reached a threshold in this period.
rowsLimited: IP rankings load 20 more rows at a time; top 20 endpoints, 30 source groups, up to 30 unusual windows and 50 recent requests.
moreFailed: Could not load more IPs. Existing rows are kept; please retry.
snapshotExpired: This ranking has expired. Refresh statistics to continue.
